contract.purpose: Pivot current shipment-detail row counts into fixed customer groups and status bands.
inputs_defaults: Only explicit declaration defaults permit omission; catalog has_default_value is not used to infer T-SQL defaults.
null_and_invalid_input_behavior: COUNT ERP_ORDER omits NULL identifiers. NULL trailing status fails the less-than-900 predicate; missing pivot cells are explicitly normalized with ISNULL before outer sums.
output_shape: TRAILING_STS as a label, Others, ROTC, Lackland, PI, SD, NEXCOM, KyLOC, DRMO and one fixed cancellation-label column.

ordered_branches.explanation: Joins detail/header, filters trailing status<900 and fixed customer category, then COUNTs non-NULL detail ERP_ORDER rather than distinct orders. Fixed launch49906/49910 overrides customer grouping; otherwise fixed customer/category mapping feeds a fixed-column pivot. Status bands are <300,300..<650,650..<900 with custom output order. Outer sums ISNULL pivot values to zero. No date, quantity, warehouse or caller filter.

limitations: This is the retained 2026-09-29 replica capture, not a new database inspection. NO_CAPTURED_REFERENCE means none of the credited channels in this exact retained corpus identified the table. It does not establish that the table is unused, obsolete, a backup, safe to delete, or absent from external application SQL.
